removal.policy: Application-facing uninstall is a generic Gesher user-mediated extension: fresh default-No host approval per operation, original caller process/code and current target/version fences, flags0/user0 and ordinary persistent targets only. No fabricated DELETE_PACKAGES grant or Google allowlist. Addon/system targets and authenticators owning active accounts remain rejected. Durable quarantine/registry recovery, no-follow cleanup and permanent capability retirement prevent old-data or authority resurrection.
